sentences.zh: 宗室奕功札隆阿等覺羅清廉等松林文炘等

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yigong, Zhalong'a, and others; Aisin Gioro Qinglian and others; Songlin, Wenxin, and others
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Yigong, Zhalong'a, and others; Aisin Gioro Qinglian and others; Songlin, Wenxin, and others

sentences.zh: 崇壽韓紹徽韓培森馬鍾祺董瀚譚昌祺莊禮本馮福疇

translations.literal: Chongshou, Han Shaohui, Han Peisen, Ma Zhongqi, Dong Han, Tan Changqi, Zhuang Liben, Feng Fuchou
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou, Han Shaohui, Han Peisen, Ma Zhongqi, Dong Han, Tan Changqi, Zhuang Liben, and Feng Fuchou

sentences.zh: 宮玉森景善等宋春華馬福祿楊福同

translations.literal: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua, Ma Fulu, Yang Futong
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua, Ma Fulu, and Yang Futong

sentences.zh: 吳德潚子仲韜成肇麟

translations.literal: Wu Deshen, his son Zhongtao, Cheng Zhaolin
translations.idiomatic: Wu Deshen, his son Zhongtao, and Cheng Zhaolin

sentences.zh: 宗室奕功，歷官奉宸苑卿，至御前侍衛。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yigong served in succession as Director of the Imperial Gardens and Parks and rose to Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansman Yigong served as Director of the Imperial Gardens and Parks before rising to Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十六年，拳匪肇禍，各國聯軍破京都，德宗奉孝欽顯皇后西狩，奕功以世受國恩，未能隨扈，引火自焚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu, the Boxers caused trouble; the allied armies of the foreign powers broke into the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaojinxian on the western flight; Yigong, having received the dynasty's grace for generations, was unable to follow the imperial retinue and set himself afire.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 the Boxers sparked disaster, the allied foreign armies took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu fled west with Empress Dowager Cixi. Yigong, who had received the dynasty's favor for generations, could not join the flight and burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 妻祥佳氏、子載捷等，闔家投井殉節。

translations.literal: His wife, Lady Xiangjia, his son Zaijie, and others—his whole household threw themselves into a well and died for their loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Xiangjia, his son Zaijie, and the rest of the household threw themselves into a well and died together.

sentences.zh: 先後被難者，宗室有奉恩將軍札隆阿，子樸誠等；

translations.literal: Among those who met disaster in succession, among the imperial clansmen were Fenyin General Zhalong'a and his son Pucheng and others;
translations.idiomatic: Among the imperial clansmen who perished were Fenyin General Zhalong'a and his son Pucheng;

sentences.zh: 奉恩將軍緝禦，子培善，孫存德、存厚等；

translations.literal: Fenyin General Jiyu, his son Peishan, his grandsons Cunde and Cunhou and others;
translations.idiomatic: Fenyin General Jiyu, his son Peishan, and his grandsons Cunde and Cunhou;

sentences.zh: 文舉人恩煦，子繼勳、懋勳，從子啟勳、世勳等；

translations.literal: Wen juren Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, his nephews Qixun and Shixun and others;
translations.idiomatic: Wen juren Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, and his nephews Qixun and Shixun;

sentences.zh: 掌江西道監察御史德籓，戶部員外郎恩斝，戶部主事謹善，宗人府經歷訥欽，頭等侍衛德潤，帶隊官鈺璋，及奕鑫、載袍、恕誠、聯德、恩溥、鬆達、善章、國文、松根、景璋、承惠、和桂、鳳喜、吉辰、海明，覺羅有清廉、年瑞、德潤、榮綿。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor of the Jiangxi Circuit Defan, Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue Enjia, Section Chief in the Ministry of Revenue Jinshan, Registrar in the Imperial Clan Court Neqin, First-class Bodyguard Derun, Detachment Commander Yuzhang, and Yixin, Zaipao, Shucheng, Liande, Enpu, Songda, Shanzhang, Guowen, Songgen, Jingzhang, Chenghui, He'gui, Fengxi, Jichen, Haiming; among the Aisin Gioro were Qinglian, Nianrui, Derun, and Rongmian.

sentences.zh: 松林，巴雅爾氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Songlin, of the Bayar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Songlin, of the Bayar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式累擢給事中。

translations.literal: Starting as a clerk, he was promoted in succession to Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from clerk to Supervising Secretary through successive promotions.

sentences.zh: 出知臨安府，升雲南糧儲道，晉山東按察使、布政使。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Lin'an, was promoted to Grain Intendant of Yunnan, and advanced to Shandong Surveillance Commissioner and Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Lin'an, then as Yunnan Grain Intendant, and was promoted to Shandong Surveillance Commissioner and Provincial Administration Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 內擢順天府府尹，病解任，起為內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was selected within the capital as Prefect of Shuntian, resigned on account of illness, and was recalled as a Reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Prefect of Shuntian in the capital, resigned due to illness, and was later recalled as a Reader in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 聯軍犯京師，分守東直門，親指揮砲火中，抵禦甚力。

translations.literal: When the allied armies attacked the capital, he was assigned to hold Dongzhimen Gate and personally directed the defense amid cannon fire with great effort.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies attacked the capital, he was posted to defend Dongzhimen Gate and personally directed the defense under heavy fire.

sentences.zh: 俄中砲死，屍不可辨。

translations.literal: Soon he was struck by a cannonball and killed; his corpse could not be identified.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon struck by a cannonball and killed; his body was unrecognizable.

translations.idiomatic: department director of the Caiyu Camp Yang Guangdi, on the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary eighth month, upon hearing that foreign soldiers had arrived, sat in full dress in the camp and was shot dead;

sentences.zh: 把總張進志擁護同死。

translations.literal: platoon commander Zhang Jinzhi died defending him.
translations.idiomatic: platoon commander Zhang Jinzhi died defending him.

sentences.zh: 均經留京辦事大臣崑岡上聞，贈卹有差。

translations.literal: All were reported by the Minister Resident in the Capital Kunkang and received posthumous honors in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: All were reported by Minister Resident Kunkang and received posthumous honors in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 崇壽，溫徹亨氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Chongshou, of the Wencheheng clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou, of the Wencheheng clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 光緒十六年進士，入翰林，累擢翰林院侍讀。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy, and rose in succession to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 16 he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy, and rose in succession to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 變作時，不勝憂憤，仰藥死。

translations.literal: When the upheaval came, overcome with grief and indignation, he took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the upheaval came, overcome with grief and indignation, he took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 詔以「見危授命」褒之，諡文貞。

translations.literal: An edict praised him with the phrase "facing peril, he gave his life," and he was granted the posthumous title Wen Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him with the phrase "facing peril, he gave his life," and he was granted the posthumous title Wen Zhen.

sentences.zh: 韓紹徽，字筱珊，貴州貴陽人。

translations.literal: Han Shaohui, courtesy name Xiaoshan, was a native of Guiyang, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shaohui, courtesy name Xiaoshan, was a native of Guiyang, Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年進士，授主事，分刑部，勤於所職。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a secretary, and was assigned to the Board of Punishments, where he was diligent in his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a secretary, and was assigned to the Board of Punishments, where he was diligent in his duties.

sentences.zh: 拳亂初起，嘗走同官，涕泣誓身殉。

translations.literal: When the Boxer turmoil first arose, he once went to a colleague in tears and swore to die for the cause.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer turmoil first arose, he once went to a colleague in tears and swore to die for the cause.

sentences.zh: 七月二十一日，自經於陝西司司堂。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Department.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Department.

sentences.zh: 掌江西道御史韓培森，巡城積勞，城破，絕食死。

translations.literal: Censor-in-charge of the Jiangxi Circuit Han Peisen, worn out by long patrol duty, starved himself to death when the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-charge of the Jiangxi Circuit Han Peisen, worn out by long patrol duty, starved himself to death when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 內閣中書堃厚，手書「見危授命」四字，與妻同縊死。

translations.literal: Grand Secretariat drafter Kunhou wrote with his own hand the four characters "facing peril, give one's life" and hanged himself together with his wife.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat drafter Kunhou wrote with his own hand the four characters "facing peril, give one's life" and hanged himself together with his wife.

sentences.zh: 馬鍾祺，字維春，隸漢軍鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: Ma Zhongqi, courtesy name Weichun, was a Chinese Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhongqi, courtesy name Weichun, was a Chinese Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 少為諸生，以襲一等子，例不得與試，授三等侍衛，擢二等，有文武才。

translations.literal: In youth he was a licentiate; having inherited a first-class marquisate, by regulation he could not sit for the examinations. He was appointed a third-rank imperial bodyguard, promoted to the second rank, and possessed both civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was a licentiate; having inherited a first-class marquisate, by regulation he could not sit for the examinations. He was appointed a third-rank imperial bodyguard, promoted to the second rank, and possessed both civil and military talent.

sentences.zh: 初服膺陸、王之學，繼參以程、硃、張、呂，不主一家。

translations.literal: At first he devoted himself to the learning of Lu and Wang; later he drew also on Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü, and did not adhere to any single school.
translations.idiomatic: At first he devoted himself to the learning of Lu and Wang; later he drew also on Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü, and did not adhere to any single school.

sentences.zh: 為人伉爽有奇氣，慕孫白谷之為人，好與朝野賢士遊，與語或不合，輒哦詩亂之，以此得狂名。

translations.literal: By nature he was forthright and possessed an uncommon spirit; he admired the character of Sun Baigu and delighted in associating with worthy men throughout court and country. When conversation did not agree with him, he would chant poetry to disrupt it, and for this he gained a reputation for eccentricity.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was forthright and possessed an uncommon spirit; he admired the character of Sun Baigu and delighted in associating with worthy men throughout court and country. When conversation did not agree with him, he would chant poetry to disrupt it, and for this he gained a reputation for eccentricity.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，日本爭朝鮮，廷議出師，鍾祺上書請自效，遂從戎奉天。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu, when Japan disputed Korea and the court debated sending troops, Zhongqi submitted a memorial asking to serve in person and accordingly went north to take the field in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20, when Japan disputed Korea and the court debated sending troops, Zhongqi submitted a memorial asking to serve in person and accordingly went north to take the field in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 盛京將軍依克唐阿器之，使統鎮邊馬隊。

translations.literal: Shengjing General Yiketang'a valued him and had him command the border horse brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Shengjing General Yiketang'a valued him and had him command the border horse brigade.

sentences.zh: 會和議定，遂歸。

translations.literal: When peace was concluded he returned.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was concluded he returned.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，李秉衡奉旨巡視長江，親訪於家，疏請從行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Li Bingheng, by imperial order inspecting the Yangtze, visited him at home and memorialized asking that he accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25 Li Bingheng, by imperial order inspecting the Yangtze, visited him at home and memorialized asking that he accompany him.

sentences.zh: 拳匪禍作，冒鋒火而北，秉衡殉難，鍾祺護其喪歸。

translations.literal: When the Boxer disaster arose, he braved fire and steel to go north; Bingheng died for the state, and Zhongqi escorted his coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer disaster arose, he braved fire and steel to go north; Bingheng died for the state, and Zhongqi escorted his coffin home.

sentences.zh: 歸三日，京師破，鍾祺自縊死。

translations.literal: Three days after his return the capital fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after his return the capital fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 著五倫大義、馬氏日記若干卷。

translations.literal: He authored several volumes of The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary.
translations.idiomatic: He authored several volumes of The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary.

sentences.zh: 候選縣丞董瀚，於城破日與弟候補巡檢徵曰：「我等職雖微末，既讀聖賢書，惟有以身殉國而已。

translations.literal: Candidate district magistrate Dong Han, on the day the city fell, said to his younger brother, candidate sub-prefectural inspector Zheng: "Though our offices are humble, having read the sages' books, we can only give our bodies to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Candidate district magistrate Dong Han, on the day the city fell, said to his younger brother, candidate sub-prefectural inspector Zheng: "Though our offices are humble, having read the sages' books, we can only give our bodies to the state.

sentences.zh: 」同時自縊。

translations.literal: " They hanged themselves at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: " They hanged themselves at the same time.

sentences.zh: 涿州附生譚昌祺，聞城陷，懷藥哭諸聖廟，仰藥死。

translations.literal: Zhuozhou licentiate Tan Changqi, upon hearing that the city had fallen, took poison in his arms, wept before the temple of the sages, and died by poison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuozhou licentiate Tan Changqi, upon hearing that the city had fallen, took poison in his arms, wept before the temple of the sages, and died by poison.

sentences.zh: 舉人莊禮本，留京讀書。

translations.literal: Recommended man Zhuang Liben remained in the capital to study.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended man Zhuang Liben remained in the capital to study.

sentences.zh: 拳匪初起，即以為憂。

translations.literal: When the Boxers first arose he was already troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers first arose he was already troubled.

sentences.zh: 洋兵入城，痛哭不食，後以一慟而絕。

translations.literal: When foreign soldiers entered the city he wept and refused food, and later died in a single paroxysm of grief.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign soldiers entered the city he wept and refused food, and later died in a single paroxysm of grief.

sentences.zh: 州同銜馮福疇，在通州署辦刑名事。

translations.literal: Sub-prefect Feng Fuchou was handling criminal matters at the Tongzhou yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Sub-prefect Feng Fuchou was handling criminal matters at the Tongzhou yamen.

sentences.zh: 七月十六日，敵入署，守護案牘，不屈，被戕。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month the enemy entered the yamen; he guarded the case records, would not submit, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month the enemy entered the yamen; he guarded the case records, would not submit, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 東城司吏目、練勇局委員宮玉森，洋兵攻局，其女請避，怒投其女於井，拔刀出戰。

translations.literal: Gong Yusen, sub-bureau clerk of the Eastern City and committee member of the Militia Bureau, when foreign soldiers attacked the bureau and his daughter asked to flee, angrily threw his daughter into a well, drew his sword, and went out to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, sub-bureau clerk of the Eastern City and committee member of the Militia Bureau, when foreign soldiers attacked the bureau and his daughter asked to flee, angrily threw his daughter into a well, drew his sword, and went out to fight.

sentences.zh: 傷數處，自知不免，亦投井死。

translations.literal: Wounded in several places and knowing he could not escape, he too threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded in several places and knowing he could not escape, he too threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 時同被難者，為原品休緻禮部侍郎景善，前奉天府尹福裕，蒙古副都統耆齡，前察哈爾副都統明秀，冠軍使文琭，工科給事中恩順，刑部郎中汪以莊，兵部員外郎薩德賀、趙寶書，吏部主事鍾傑，戶部主事陶見曾、李慕、鐵山，刑部主事毛煥樞、王者馨，工部主事白慶、恆昌，理籓院主事英順，光祿寺署丞多文，國子監助教柏山，候選道鄭錫敞，前紹興府知府繼恩，分省知縣王朝鐀等，見冊報者千餘人。

translations.literal: At the time those who suffered disaster with them included former Vice Minister of Rites Jingshan, who had retired at his original rank; former Prefect of Shuntian Fu Fuyu; Mongol Vice Commander-in-chief Qiling; former Vice Commander-in-chief of Chahar Mingxiu; Champion Envoy Wenyu; supervising secretary of the Board of Works Enshun; Board of Punishments director Wang Yizhuang; Board of War outer secretary Sadehe and Zhao Baoshu; Board of Civil Appointments secretary Zhong Jie; Board of Revenue secretaries Tao Jianzeng, Li Mu, and Tieshan; Board of Punishments secretaries Mao Huanqu and Wang Zhexin; Board of Works secretaries Bai Qing and Hengchang; Board of the Court of Colonial Affairs secretary Yingshun; acting vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Duowen; National University assistant instructor Baishan; candidate intendant Zheng Xichang; former Prefect of Shaoxing Fu Ji'en; sub-prefect Wang Chaokun and others; more than a thousand names appear in the registers.
translations.idiomatic: At the time those who suffered disaster with them included former Vice Minister of Rites Jingshan, who had retired at his original rank; former Prefect of Shuntian Fu Fuyu; Mongol Vice Commander-in-chief Qiling; former Vice Commander-in-chief of Chahar Mingxiu; Champion Envoy Wenyu; supervising secretary of the Board of Works Enshun; Board of Punishments director Wang Yizhuang; Board of War outer secretaries Sadehe and Zhao Baoshu; Board of Civil Appointments secretary Zhong Jie; Board of Revenue secretaries Tao Jianzeng, Li Mu, and Tieshan; Board of Punishments secretaries Mao Huanqu and Wang Zhexin; Board of Works secretaries Bai Qing and Hengchang; Board of the Court of Colonial Affairs secretary Yingshun; acting vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Duowen; National University assistant instructor Baishan; candidate intendant Zheng Xichang; former Prefect of Shaoxing Fu Ji'en; sub-prefect Wang Chaokun and others; more than a thousand names appear in the registers.

sentences.zh: 全家焚溺服毒自經以盡節者眾，騎都尉候選員外郎陳鑾，住東便門二閘，於七月十九日洋人攻城，勢急，與諸弟率眷屬僕婢三十二名，一時自盡，尤為慘烈雲。

translations.literal: Many whole families burned themselves, drowned themselves, took poison, or hanged themselves to complete their loyalty. Chen Luan, candidate outer secretary and cavalry commandant, lived at the second lock of Dongbian Gate; on the nineteenth day of the seventh month, when foreign soldiers attacked the city and the situation grew desperate, he and his younger brothers led thirty-two dependents and servants to die together at one time—a case said to be especially tragic.
translations.idiomatic: Many whole families burned themselves, drowned themselves, took poison, or hanged themselves to complete their loyalty. Chen Luan, candidate outer secretary and cavalry commandant, lived at the second lock of Dongbian Gate; on the nineteenth day of the seventh month, when foreign soldiers attacked the city and the situation grew desperate, he and his younger brothers led thirty-two dependents and servants to die together at one time—a case said to be especially tragic.

sentences.zh: 宋春華，字實菴，陝西三原人。

translations.literal: Song Chunhua, courtesy name Shian, was a native of Sanyuan, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chunhua, courtesy name Shian, was a native of Sanyuan, Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年武進士，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu he passed the military metropolitan examination and was appointed a blue-tailed imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 he passed the military metropolitan examination and was appointed a blue-tailed imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為天津鎮標右營守備，與士卒共甘苦，所部為天津綠營冠。

translations.literal: He went out as garrison commander of the Right Camp of the Tianjin garrison brigade, shared hardship with his soldiers, and his command was counted the finest of the Tianjin Green Standard Army.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as garrison commander of the Right Camp of the Tianjin garrison brigade, shared hardship with his soldiers, and his command was counted the finest of the Tianjin Green Standard Army.

sentences.zh: 聯軍內犯，總督裕祿檄春華守城南門。

translations.literal: When the allied armies invaded inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to defend the southern city gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies invaded inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to defend the southern city gate.

sentences.zh: 城東南製造軍械所不守，春華集其眾曰：「軍械所存亡，天津生死系之。

translations.literal: The ordnance works southeast of the city were undefended. Chunhua gathered his men and said: "Whether the ordnance works stand or fall binds the life and death of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: The ordnance works southeast of the city were undefended. Chunhua gathered his men and said: "Whether the ordnance works stand or fall binds the life and death of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 不奪歸不可，膽勇者盍隨吾出城！

translations.literal: We cannot fail to retake them—let any with courage follow me out of the city!
translations.idiomatic: We cannot fail to retake them—let any with courage follow me out of the city!

sentences.zh: 」皆應曰：「諾！

translations.literal: " All answered: "Yes!
translations.idiomatic: " All answered: "Yes!

sentences.zh: 」率百餘人夜半潛出，及庫垣，春華先登，眾隨之。

translations.literal: " He led more than a hundred men and stole out at midnight; reaching the depot wall, Chunhua climbed first and the rest followed.
translations.idiomatic: " He led more than a hundred men and stole out at midnight; reaching the depot wall, Chunhua climbed first and the rest followed.

sentences.zh: 槍中春華左股，眾欲退，春華負創大呼曰：「今夕之事，有進無退！

translations.literal: A shot struck Chunhua in the left thigh; the men wished to withdraw, but Chunhua, bearing his wound, shouted: "Tonight's affair admits advance, not retreat!
translations.idiomatic: A shot struck Chunhua in the left thigh; the men wished to withdraw, but Chunhua, bearing his wound, shouted: "Tonight's affair admits advance, not retreat!

sentences.zh: 」眾爭奪敵，死傷甚眾，卒以守堅，退歸城。

translations.literal: " The men vied to seize the enemy; casualties were heavy, but because the defenders held firm, they withdrew back to the city.
translations.idiomatic: " The men vied to seize the enemy; casualties were heavy, but because the defenders held firm, they withdrew back to the city.

sentences.zh: 已而敵兵日集，守土官多棄城走，春華慨語其妻陳曰：「城孤兵單，終恐不守。

translations.literal: Before long enemy troops gathered day by day, and many territorial officials abandoned the city and fled. Chunhua spoke with feeling to his wife Chen, saying: "The city is isolated and our troops are few; in the end I fear it cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the enemy was gathering daily, and many local officials abandoned the city and fled. Chunhua spoke earnestly to his wife Chen: "The city stands alone and our forces are too few—we will not be able to hold it in the end.

sentences.zh: 汝當以吾子出求生，吾誓與城存亡矣！

translations.literal: You must take our son and go out to seek survival; I swear to live and die with the city!
translations.idiomatic: Take our son and flee to save yourselves. I swear to live and die with this city!

sentences.zh: 」語畢，登陴督戰不少息。

translations.literal: " When he had finished speaking, he mounted the battlements to direct the fighting without the least pause.
translations.idiomatic: " When he had finished, he mounted the battlements and directed the fighting without a moment's rest.

sentences.zh: 城既陷，身被數傷，猶死守不​​退。

translations.literal: When the city had fallen, though his body bore many wounds, he still held fast and would not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: After the city fell, though he had suffered many wounds, he still held his ground and refused to retreat.

sentences.zh: 或勸少避，春華曰：「城不守，死自吾分。

translations.literal: Some urged him to withdraw briefly. Chunhua said: "If the city cannot be held, death is my portion.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged him to pull back for a time. Chunhua said: "If the city cannot be held, then death is my duty alone.

sentences.zh: 汝曹各有父母妻子，歸可也，俱死無益！

translations.literal: You each have parents, wives, and children—you may go home; to die all together would serve no purpose!
translations.idiomatic: Each of you has parents, wives, and children—go home if you can. To die together would accomplish nothing!

sentences.zh: 」眾感其義，無退者。

translations.literal: " The men were moved by his integrity, and none withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " Moved by his devotion, not one of them retreated.

sentences.zh: 敵畢登城，乃仰天歎曰：「吾志不遂，負國恩矣！

translations.literal: When the enemy had fully mounted the walls, he looked up to heaven and sighed: "My purpose is unfulfilled—I have failed the state's grace!
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy had fully taken the walls, he looked up to heaven and sighed: "My purpose is unfulfilled—I have betrayed the grace of the state!

sentences.zh: 然自接戰以來，殺敵過當，今日之死，亦無所恨。

translations.literal: Yet from the day we joined battle I have slain the enemy far beyond count; to die today I have no regret.
translations.idiomatic: Yet since we first joined battle I have killed the enemy far beyond count. To die today, I have no regret.

sentences.zh: 」以首觸陴，腦出，死，年三十五。

translations.literal: " He dashed his head against the battlement; his brains burst out, and he died at the age of thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: " He dashed his head against the battlement; his brains burst forth, and he died at the age of thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 馬福祿，字壽三，甘肅河州人。

translations.literal: Ma Fulu, courtesy name Shousan, was a native of Hezhou, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Fulu, courtesy name Shousan, was a native of Hezhou, Gansu.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年武進士，用衛守備，歸河南鎮標，以終養告歸。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed the military metropolitan examination, was appointed a garrison guard-commander, returned to the Henan garrison brigade, and requested leave to retire and care for his parents to the end.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 he passed the military metropolitan examination, was appointed garrison guard-commander, returned to the Henan garrison brigade, and later requested leave to retire and care for his parents until their death.

sentences.zh: 二十年，循化撒拉回族以爭教叛，固原提督雷正綰檄福祿往崔家峽、樊家峽協防，戰輒勝。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the Salar Hui of Xunhua rebelled over a sect dispute, Gansu Brigade General Lei Zhengkuan ordered Fulu to Cuijiaxia and Fanjiaxia to assist in defense; in battle he always won.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20, when the Salar Hui of Xunhua rebelled over a sect dispute, Gansu Brigade General Lei Zhengkuan dispatched Fulu to Cuijiaxia and Fanjiaxia to assist in the defense, and he won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 河、湟回匪繼起，复助官兵獲大捷。

translations.literal: Hui rebels rose in succession along the Huang and Huangshui rivers; he again aided the government troops and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui rebels rose in succession in the Huang and Huangshui valleys, he again assisted the government troops and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 累功至記名總兵。

translations.literal: Through accumulated merit he rose to acting brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: Through accumulated merit he rose to acting brigade general.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河州諸回變，福祿本回教，回以福祿助官軍，欲加害。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Hui of Hezhou revolted. Fulu was himself a Muslim; the rebels, because Fulu aided the government army, wished to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 the Hui of Hezhou revolted. Fulu was himself a Muslim, and because he aided the government army the rebels sought to kill him.

sentences.zh: 福祿在城，人亦以回教為疑，獨正綰信之。

translations.literal: While Fulu was in the city, people also suspected him on account of his faith; only Zhengkuan trusted him.
translations.idiomatic: While Fulu was in the city, others also doubted him because of his faith; only Zhengkuan trusted him.

sentences.zh: 時河州鎮總兵湯彥和遠駐起乍堡，命福祿率騎兵迎入河州城鎮之，彥和猶豫不果行，叛回週七十乃糾眾據山巔下擊。

translations.literal: At that time Hezhou brigade general Tang Yanhe was stationed far away at Qichazhai; he ordered Fulu to lead cavalry to welcome him into Hezhou city to suppress the rebels. Yanhe hesitated and did not go; the rebel leader Zhou Qishi gathered his followers on the mountain heights and struck downward.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hezhou brigade general Tang Yanhe was encamped far away at Qichazhai. He ordered Fulu to lead cavalry to escort him into Hezhou and suppress the rebels, but Yanhe hesitated and never came. The rebel leader Zhou Qishi gathered his men on the mountain heights and struck downward.

sentences.zh: 福祿戰二日，以失地利無功。

translations.literal: Fulu fought for two days but, having lost the advantage of terrain, achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu fought for two days but, deprived of favorable ground, achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 彥和復潛走，軍無統帥，賊益蹙之。

translations.literal: Yanhe again slipped away in secret; the army had no commander-in-chief, and the rebels pressed them even harder.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhe again slipped away in secret. With no commander over the army, the rebels pressed them ever harder.

sentences.zh: 福祿乃突圍出南番境，至蘭州乞師。

translations.literal: Fulu then broke through the encirclement and crossed into the Nanfan region, reaching Lanzhou to beg for reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu then broke through the encirclement into the Nanfan region and reached Lanzhou to beg for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 沿路拔出難民數千，難民德之，狀總督楊昌濬，昌濬以福祿孚眾望，乃檄與蘭州道黃雲由北路援河州。

translations.literal: Along the way he rescued several thousand refugees. The refugees were grateful to him and petitioned Governor-general Yang Changjun; Yang, because Fulu enjoyed the people's trust, ordered him and Lanzhou circuit intendant Huang Yun to relieve Hezhou by the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: Along the way he rescued several thousand refugees. Grateful, they petitioned Governor-general Yang Changjun, who, seeing that Fulu enjoyed the people's trust, ordered him and Lanzhou circuit intendant Huang Yun to relieve Hezhou by the northern route.

sentences.zh: 時喀什噶爾提督董福祥奉旨赴甘肅協剿，由狄道進兵。

translations.literal: At that time Kashgar Brigade General Dong Fuxiang, by imperial order, went to Gansu to assist in the suppression and advanced by way of Didao.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Kashgar Brigade General Dong Fuxiang was ordered to Gansu to assist in the suppression and advanced by way of Didao.

sentences.zh: 福祿率師至蓮花渡，與賊隔岸相持，為福祥軍犄角，卒解河州圍。

translations.literal: Fulu led his troops to Lotus Ferry and stood off the rebels across the river, acting as a pincer with Fuxiang's army; at last the siege of Hezhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu led his troops to Lotus Ferry and held the rebels at bay across the river, coordinating with Fuxiang's army in a pincer movement until the siege of Hezhou was at last lifted.

sentences.zh: 時韓文秀亦作亂，河湟提督李培榮、總兵牛師韓軍失利，陝西巡撫魏光燾與福祥會白塔寺，議進兵。

translations.literal: At that time Han Wenxiu also rose in rebellion. Huang and Huang Brigade General Li Peirong and brigade general Niu Shihan suffered defeat. Shaanxi Governor Wei Guangdian met Fuxiang at Baitasi to plan the advance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Han Wenxiu also rebelled. Huang and Huang Brigade General Li Peirong and brigade general Niu Shihan suffered defeat. Shaanxi Governor Wei Guangdian met Fuxiang at Baitasi to plan the advance.

sentences.zh: 福祿入謁，陳亂事顛末，及前後戰狀，福祥奇之，檄剿叛回冶主麻於米拉溝。

translations.literal: Fulu went to pay his respects, set forth the whole course of the rebellion and his earlier and later battles; Fuxiang marveled at him and ordered him to suppress the rebel Hui Yezhuma at Mila Gully.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu came to pay his respects and recounted the whole course of the rebellion and his battles before and after. Fuxiang was impressed and ordered him to suppress the rebel Hui Yezhuma at Mila Gully.

sentences.zh: 剿未盡，馬營土豪馬采哥應之，福祥部將石堯臣等告敗，福祿復分道往援，首先陷陣，斬採哥，聚而殲之。

translations.literal: Before the suppression was complete, the local strongman Macaige of Ma Camp responded to the rebellion. Fuxiang's subordinates Shi Yaochan and others reported defeat. Fulu again divided his forces to go to their aid, was the first to break the enemy line, beheaded Caige, and gathered the force to annihilate it.
translations.idiomatic: Before the suppression was complete, the local strongman Macaige of Ma Camp rose in support. Fuxiang's subordinates Shi Yaochan and others reported defeat. Fulu again divided his forces to go to their aid, was the first to break the enemy line, beheaded Caige, and annihilated the rebel band.

sentences.zh: 冶主麻收餘燼由黑山趨米拉，復還兵破之，斬無算，用是有驍將名。

translations.literal: Yezhuma gathered the embers of his force, went from Heishan toward Mila, and Fulu turned back to smash him, beheading beyond count; by this he gained the reputation of a valiant general.
translations.idiomatic: Yezhuma gathered the remnants of his force and fled from Heishan toward Mila. Fulu turned back, smashed him, and beheaded beyond count; by this he gained the reputation of a valiant general.

sentences.zh: 拳匪倡亂，福祥奉旨入都，檄福祿統馬步七營、旗防山海關，尋移永平府，福祥入衛京師，檄隨行。

translations.literal: When the Boxers raised rebellion, Fuxiang was ordered to the capital and dispatched Fulu to command seven battalions of horse and foot to guard Shanhaiguan. Soon he was transferred to Yongping prefecture; when Fuxiang entered the capital to defend it, he ordered Fulu to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers raised rebellion, Fuxiang was ordered to the capital and dispatched Fulu to command seven battalions of horse and foot to guard Shanhaiguan. Soon he was transferred to Yongping prefecture; when Fuxiang entered the capital to defend it, he ordered Fulu to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 五月，各國聯軍躪楊村而西，偕漢中鎮總兵姚旺等赴黃村御之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the allied armies of the foreign powers trampled Yangcun and marched west; together with Hanzhong brigade general Yao Wang and others, he went to Huangcun to oppose them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the allied armies trampled Yangcun and marched west; together with Hanzhong brigade general Yao Wang and others, he went to Huangcun to oppose them.

sentences.zh: 抵廊坊，​​兩軍相接，乃令騎兵下設七覆，步兵張兩翼，敵近始發槍，倒者如僕牆。

translations.literal: Reaching Langfang, the two armies met; he then ordered the cavalry to dismount and set seven ambushes, the infantry to spread on both wings; only when the enemy drew near did they open fire, and the fallen were like toppling walls.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Langfang, the two armies met. He ordered the cavalry to dismount and lay seven ambushes while the infantry spread on both wings; they opened fire only when the enemy drew near, and the fallen were like walls collapsing.

sentences.zh: 敵彈落如雨，騎兵以散處少傷，兩翼左右复包抄其後，短兵相接，敵不支，遽卻，為庚子之役第一惡戰。

translations.literal: Enemy bullets fell like rain; the cavalry, scattered, suffered few casualties, and the wings again enveloped them from left and right. At close quarters the enemy could not hold and hastily withdrew; this was the first bitter battle of the Boxer year campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy bullets fell like rain. The cavalry, scattered, suffered few casualties, while the wings enveloped the enemy from both sides. At close quarters the enemy could not hold and hastily withdrew; this was the first bitter battle of the Boxer year campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，福祥檄令攻使館，中彈歿於陣，猶子耀圖、兆圖亦死，同殉者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an attack on the legation quarter; Fulu was struck by a bullet and died on the field; his nephew's sons Yaotu and Zhaotu also died, and more than a hundred died together with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an attack on the legation quarter. Fulu was struck by a bullet and died on the field; his grandnephews Yaotu and Zhaotu also died, and more than a hundred died with him.

sentences.zh: 楊福同，直隸清苑人。

translations.literal: Yang Futong was a native of Qingyuan, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Futong was a native of Qingyuan, Zhili.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，投軍，累擢游擊，從討朝陽教匪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi he joined the army; through successive promotions he rose to brigade commander and took part in suppressing the Chaoyang sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 he joined the army, rose through successive promotions to brigade commander, and took part in suppressing the Chaoyang sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 嗣以副將駐營大名，專力緝捕，以功記名總兵，分統練軍左翼馬隊，兼統天津馬步隊各營。

translations.literal: Later, as a vice general he was stationed at camp in Daming, devoting himself to pursuit and capture; through merit he was named acting brigade general, commanded the left-wing horse brigade of the drilled army, and also commanded the various horse and foot battalions of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as vice general he was stationed at Daming and devoted himself to pursuit and capture. Through merit he was named acting brigade general, commanded the left-wing horse brigade of the drilled army, and also commanded the various horse and foot battalions of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 近畿拳匪蜂起，淶水尤甚，總督裕祿檄福同率隊往。

translations.literal: Boxers swarmed up around the capital region; Laishui was especially severe. Governor Yulu ordered Futong to lead his detachment there.
translations.idiomatic: Boxers swarmed up around the capital region, Laishui worst of all. Governor Yulu ordered Futong to lead his detachment there.

sentences.zh: 至史家莊，伏匪邀擊，力御之，擒數人。

translations.literal: Reaching Shijiazhuang, ambushing rebels intercepted him; he fought them off strenuously and captured several men.
translations.idiomatic: At Shijiazhuang, ambushing rebels intercepted him; he fought them off strenuously and captured several men.

sentences.zh: 次日，又敗匪於石亭鎮，擒首要梁修。

translations.literal: The next day he again defeated the rebels at Shiting Town and captured the ringleader Liang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he again defeated the rebels at Shiting Town and captured the ringleader Liang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 福同不忍多誅，令限日解散，留馬隊三十人鎮之。

translations.literal: Futong could not bear to execute many; he ordered them to disband within a set number of days and left thirty cavalry to hold the place.
translations.idiomatic: Futong could not bear to execute many. He ordered them to disband within a set number of days and left thirty cavalry to hold the place.

sentences.zh: 無何，匪以千餘眾攻留隊，福同率步兵數十馳援。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels attacked the garrison with more than a thousand men; Futong led several dozen infantrymen in a rush to their relief.
translations.idiomatic: Before long more than a thousand rebels attacked the garrison. Futong led several dozen infantrymen in a rush to their relief.

sentences.zh: 將及石亭，群匪自溝中突出，白刃交下，創甚，猶格殺數人，力盡死之。

translations.literal: As he was nearing Shiting, the rebel band burst forth from the gullies and blades rained down; badly wounded, he still killed several in hand-to-hand fighting and died when his strength was spent.
translations.idiomatic: As he was nearing Shiting, the rebel band burst from the gullies and blades rained down on him. Badly wounded, he still killed several in hand-to-hand fighting and died when his strength was spent.

sentences.zh: 從弁孫裕清、盧興璠俱力戰死，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: His subordinates Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan both fought to the death; posthumous relief was granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan both fought to the death. Posthumous relief was granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 吳德潚，字筱村，四川達縣人。

translations.literal: Wu Deshen, courtesy name Xiaocun, was a native of Daxian, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Deshen, courtesy name Xiaocun, was a native of Daxian, Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 性至孝。

translations.literal: By nature he was profoundly filial.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was profoundly filial.

sentences.zh: 博極群書，以進士用知縣。

translations.literal: He read exhaustively across all books and, as a metropolitan graduate, was appointed district magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He read exhaustively across all fields of learning and, as a metropolitan graduate, was appointed district magistrate.

sentences.zh: 庚子年，任浙江，西安、北京拳亂起，江山縣土匪以仇教為名，連陷江山、常山，縣人咸欲應之，德潚謂北事未定，洋人必不宜殲。

translations.literal: In the Boxer year 1900, while serving in Zhejiang, the Boxer troubles broke out in Xi'an and Beijing; bandits in Jiangshan county, under the name of hating the foreign religion, seized in succession Jiangshan and Changshan. The people of the county all wished to join them. Deshen said the situation in the north was not settled and that foreigners must not be extirpated.
translations.idiomatic: In the Boxer year 1900, while serving in Zhejiang, the Boxer troubles broke out in Xi'an and Beijing. Bandits in Jiangshan county, under the banner of hating the foreign religion, seized Jiangshan and Changshan in succession, and the people of the county all wished to join them. Deshen said the situation in the north was not yet settled and that foreigners must not be wiped out.

sentences.zh: 有羅楠者，素健訟，德潚嘗嚴懲之，久含恨。

translations.literal: One Luo Nan was by nature litigious; Deshen had once punished him severely, and he had long nursed hatred.
translations.idiomatic: One Luo Nan was by nature litigious. Deshen had once punished him severely, and he had long nursed a grudge.

sentences.zh: 結都司週之德，挾眾指德潚袒洋教，劫德潚縛道署轅門，盡鑷鬚髮，以利刃攢刺，洞腹死，德潚罵不絕口。

translations.literal: He banded together with garrison commander Zhou Zhide, and with a mob accused Deshen of favoring the foreign religion; they seized Deshen, bound him at the main gate of the circuit yamen, plucked out all his beard and hair, and stabbed him repeatedly with sharp blades until he died with a pierced belly; Deshen cursed them without cease.
translations.idiomatic: He joined with garrison commander Zhou Zhide and, at the head of a mob, accused Deshen of favoring the foreign religion. They seized Deshen, bound him at the main gate of the circuit yamen, plucked out all his beard and hair, and stabbed him repeatedly with sharp blades until he died with a pierced belly. Deshen cursed them without cease.

sentences.zh: 子仲韜馳哭屍下，又殺之，併入縣署殺全家四十餘口。

translations.literal: His son Zhongtao rushed to weep beneath the corpse and was also killed; they then entered the county yamen and killed more than forty members of the whole family.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhongtao rushed to weep over the body and was also killed. They then entered the county yamen and killed more than forty members of the entire family.

sentences.zh: 事定，卹如例。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, posthumous relief was granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored, posthumous relief was granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 成肇麟，江蘇華亭人。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhaolin was a native of Huating, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhaolin was a native of Huating, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父孺，諸生，列儒林傳。

translations.literal: His father Ru was a licentiate, listed in the Confucian Biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ru was a licentiate listed in the Confucian Biographies.

sentences.zh: 肇麟由舉人官直隸知縣，遷直隸州知州，署滄州靜海，補靈壽，所至有績。

translations.literal: Zhaolin, from recommended man, served as Zhili district magistrate, was promoted to Zhili prefect, acted as magistrate of Jinghai in Cangzhou prefecture, and was confirmed at Lingshou; wherever he went he had achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaolin entered service as a recommended man and served as a Zhili district magistrate, was promoted to Zhili prefect, acted as magistrate of Jinghai in Cangzhou prefecture, and was confirmed at Lingshou; wherever he served he achieved results.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十七年，京師和議梗，聯軍西上，覃及邑境，責供牲畜糗糧甚厲，肇麟壹弗應。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Guangxu, peace talks in the capital stalled; the allied armies marched west, reaching even his county's territory; they demanded livestock and rations with great severity, and Zhaolin would not comply in the least.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 27 peace talks in the capital stalled. The allied armies marched west, reaching even his county's territory, and demanded livestock and rations with great severity. Zhaolin would not comply in the least.

sentences.zh: 俄而布政使廷雍檄至，令迎犒，肇麟自念：「不迎犒，無以全民命；

translations.literal: Soon an order came from Provincial Administration Commissioner Ting Yong to welcome and reward the troops. Zhaolin reflected to himself: "If I do not welcome and reward them, I cannot save the people's lives;
translations.idiomatic: Soon an order came from Provincial Administration Commissioner Ting Yong to welcome and reward the troops. Zhaolin reflected to himself: "If I do not welcome and reward them, I cannot save the people's lives;

sentences.zh: 迎犒，則以中國臣子助攻君父；

translations.literal: If I welcome and reward them, then as a subject of China I would be aiding an attack on my sovereign and father;
translations.idiomatic: If I welcome and reward them, then as a subject of China I would be aiding an attack on my sovereign and father;

sentences.zh: 事處兩難，守土之義無可避，惟有一死耳！

translations.literal: The matter stands between two impossibilities, and the duty of guarding the soil cannot be evaded—there is only death!
translations.idiomatic: The matter stands between two impossibilities, and the duty of guarding the soil cannot be evaded—there is only death!

sentences.zh: 」乃繕遺牒遣人間道達府，媵之以詩曰：「屈體全民命，捐軀表素懷。

translations.literal: " He then drafted a final memorial and sent a man by a secret route to reach the prefecture, appending a poem that read: "Bend the body to save the people's lives, give one's life to express one's pure intent.
translations.idiomatic: " He then drafted a final memorial and sent a man by a secret route to the prefecture, appending a poem that read: "Bend the body to save the people's lives, give one's life to express one's pure intent.

sentences.zh: 」李鴻章狀死事以上，謂其能伸大義，降敕褒嘉，贈太僕寺卿，諡恭恪，予世職。

translations.literal: " Li Hongzhang reported his death to the throne, stating that he had upheld great righteousness; an edict praised and rewarded him, granted posthumous appointment as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, the posthumous title Gong Ke, and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Hongzhang reported his death to the throne, stating that he had upheld great righteousness. An edict praised and rewarded him, granted him posthumous appointment as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, the posthumous title Gong Ke, and a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 明年，允直督請，建直隸省城專祠。

translations.literal: The next year, at the Zhili governor-general's request, a dedicated shrine was built in the Zhili provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, at the Zhili governor-general's request, a dedicated shrine was built in the Zhili provincial capital.
